└─────────────┘   └─────────────┘   └─────────────┘   └────────────┘
Features
tmux and vim as user interface.
Disk based storage.
Custom http/1.1 parser to send malformed requests.
http/1.1 and websocket support.
Prerequisites
getfattr
tmux
vim (> 8.2.4684) with the following features
channel
terminal
timers
ffuf
sqlmap
column (optional for indenting history files)
Packages
attr tmux vim ffuf sqlmap bsdmainutils
Installation
Requirements
cargo msrv 1.86.0
make
openssl
Packages
make openssl
Make
make
copy the
zxc
binary from ./target/release to $PATH. Install
vim
plugin
.
Manual Installation
Copy config files
mkdir $HOME/.config/zxc
cp ./config/{alias,config.toml,tmux.conf} $HOME/.config/zxc
Generate private key
openssl genrsa -out $HOME/.config/zxc/private.key 2048
Generate CA certificate using ./mkscripts/CA.cnf as CA config.
openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key $HOME/.config/zxc/private.key -sha256 -days 1024 -out $HOME/.config/zxc/zxca.crt -extensions v3_req -config ./mkscripts/CA.cnf
Copy vim config
mkdir -p $HOME/.vim/plugin
cp ./config/example/zxc.vim $HOME/.vim/plugin
Copy filetype plugins (optional)
cp -r ./config/example/ftplugin $HOME/.vim
Build zxc or download from release.
cargo b --release
vim plugin
Install
zxc.vim
plugin.
mkdir -p $HOME/.vim/pack/git-plugins/start/
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/hail-hydrant/zxc.vim $HOME/.vim/pack/git-plugins/start/zxc.vim
Add CA
Add CA certificate from
$HOME/.config/zxc/zxca.crt
to your trusted CA
or browser.
Usage
zxc
Options
-n, --new-name <NEW_NAME>         Session name to create
-a, --attach <ATTACH_NAME>        Attach to existing session
-p, --port <PORT>                 Proxy port to use [default: 8080]
-i, --include <INCLUDED_DOMAINS>  List of domains to proxy
-e, --exclude <EXCLUDED_DOMAINS>  List of domains to relay
--no-ws                       Relay ws connections
-d, --debug                       Debug mode
-h, --help                        Print help
-i
and
-e
are mutually exclusive . The values should be in format
domain:port
.
For example, to intercept all domains except https://
example.com,
zxc -e example.

data.title: InitWare, a portable systemd fork running on BSDs and Linux
data.author: sunshine-o
data.article_summary: InitWare是一套中间件套件，用于将服务和系统资源作为逻辑实体（称为单元）进行管理。其主要组件是一个服务管理系统，能够在NetBSD、GNU/Linux及其他现代BSD系统上运行。InitWare通过作业调度器根据依赖关系自动调度单元，并提供用户会话管理器和系统日志。它可以作为init系统或辅助服务管理系统运行，源于systemd的分支，并在许多接口上保持与systemd的兼容性。当前为alpha版本，建议在生产环境中谨慎使用，直到发布首个稳定版本。InitWare根据LGPL-2.1许可证发布，支持多种平台，并提供了详细的构建和贡献指南。

Please note that InitWare is still alpha software
. But all disclosed
security concerns have now been addressed. Running InitWare as an auxiliary
service manager under NetBSD can now, then, be regarded as safe; but beware
relying on this in production until a first stable release is made.
The InitWare Suite of Middleware allows you to manage services and system
resources as logical entities called units. It runs on NetBSD, GNU/Linux, and
all the other modern BSD systems.
Units are automatically scheduled by a job scheduler according to their
dependency specifications. A user session manager facilitates tracking of users'
login sessions, with each user provided their own dedicated service manager.
Finally the InitWare System Log provides a system-wide event log aggregating
diverse log sources.
The Suite may run either as an init system or as an auxiliary service management
system under another init system. InitWare originates as a fork of systemd and
retains compatibility with many systemd interfaces, even on non-Linux platforms.

Frequently Asked Questions
How does InitWare differ from systemd?
In three ways: InitWare is highly portable, it is more modular, and it is of a
much more clearly-defined scope. See
The InitWare philosophy
.
Some components of systemd failing to provide compelling benefits are dropped;

Dropped components
.
How compatible is InitWare with systemd?
Unit-files, the
systemctl
,
loginctl
, and
journalctl
commands (provided as
svcctl
,
sessionctl
, and
syslogctl
respectively), the systemd1 and Login1
D-Bus APIs, the sd_notify API, the journald stream and datagram socket
protocols, and several other interfaces are largely supported on all ports.
Some details differ by port. See
Systemd compatibility
.
On what platforms does InitWare run?
InitWare is native to NetBSD. It runs on NetBSD, FreeBSD, and GNU/Linux - its
first-class targets - as an init system; on macOS, DragonFly BSD and OpenBSD, it
runs as an auxiliary service manager. See
Support matrix
.
Under what licence is InitWare released?
Most code is under the GNU Library GPL v2.1, some of it is under liberal licences.
How does one build InitWare?
Install the dependencies first: these are a C toolchain, cmake, gperf, m4, awk,
pkg-config or pkgconf, and on BSD platforms, libinotify. Then run:
git submodule update --init --recursive && cmake && make && make install
See
Building
for further details.
Where will InitWare go from here?
Check the Issues and Projects tabs, or the
Roadmap
.
How can I contribute?
See
Contributing
.
Where can I find out more?
Check
the Wiki
. The
Myths and Truths
page is a good place to start.
About
The InitWare Suite of Middleware allows you to manage services and system resources as logical entities called units. Its main component is a service management ("init") system.

43568503.article_summary: InitWare是一套中间件套件，用于将服务和系统资源作为逻辑实体（称为单元）进行管理。其主要组件是一个服务管理系统，能够在NetBSD、GNU/Linux及其他现代BSD系统上运行。InitWare通过作业调度器根据依赖关系自动调度单元，并提供用户会话管理器和系统日志。它可以作为init系统或辅助服务管理系统运行，源于systemd的分支，并在许多接口上保持与systemd的兼容性。当前为alpha版本，建议在生产环境中谨慎使用，直到发布首个稳定版本。InitWare根据LGPL-2.1许可证发布，支持多种平台，并提供了详细的构建和贡献指南。
43568503.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对InitWare项目的评价及与systemd的比较

不同观点：
• LinuxBender认为InitWare项目令人印象深刻，特别是在只有4个贡献者的情况下。他认为InitWare应该在systemd之前就存在，因为它更模块化且是可选的，不会强制占用init过程的功能。他还提到在Alpine Linux上实现InitWare的可能性，并建议将其作为安装选项。同时，他对项目的活跃开发表示关注，建议贡献代码或筹集资金。

• exceptione指出systemd的集成性强，处理加密、内核签名和启动管理等功能组件的协作良好。他认为如果回到过去那种需要用户自行拼凑兼容库的方式是不理想的，尤其是对于桌面用户。他还提到systemd-resolved对于桌面环境的重要性，并建议讨论桌面与容器操作系统的不同需求。

• donnachangstein批评了将软件以LGPL许可证发布给BSD用户的做法，但赞扬了InitWare项目，认为它更接近systemd应该成为的样子，即仅作为服务控制管理器。他还提到launchd作为另一种选择。

• travisgriggs对InitWare表示赞赏，认为它符合他对systemd的期望，特别是在Linux上的使用。他希望Debian能采用这样的中间 ground选择。

• Ericson2314提到NixBSD项目，并希望InitWare能被整合到NixOS中，指出之前在NixOS社区中已有相关讨论。

• udev4096推荐使用supervisord作为Alpine上的轻量级守护进程管理工具，并对其稳定性表示赞赏。

• throw0101c提醒注意InitWare项目中被删除的组件列表，提供了一个链接供参考。

• dontlaugh感叹macOS的launchd未能被适应到Linux上，认为这可能导致统一的Unix类系统init方案的缺失。

• egberts1强调需要默认拒绝所有权限并明确选择进程所需权限的安全模式，以提高安全性并减少合规性文书工作。

• actionfromafar简单表示对项目的赞赏。

• ConanRus简短表示对另一个systemd类系统的怀疑。

• 对InitWare项目的开发活跃度及其未来发展的关注。

data.title: Show HN: OpenNutrition – A free, public nutrition database
data.author: joshdickson
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种重新构想的营养搜索工具，具有即时结果、开源和通过AI增强准确性的特点。用户可以搜索食物的营养信息，同时网站提供了隐私条款和使用条款的链接。该工具旨在提供快速、准确且透明的营养数据。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Open Nutrition App的可靠性、数据来源及其实现方式

不同观点：
• [yamihere] 认为用户生成的数据库不可靠，并对LLM（大型语言模型）生成内容的权威性和准确性提出质疑，尤其是当验证步骤本身也依赖LLM时。他还指出，产品虽然核心是AI，但营销时却弱化了AI元素，可能是因为公众对AI的不信任。
• [johnisgood] 对具体食物的营养数据提出质疑，例如大鸡蛋的胆碱含量和棕色扁豆是否需要预浸泡。他认为尽管应用有潜力，但需要更高的准确性。
• [lm28469] 提到在Safari浏览器上的技术问题，如搜索框失去焦点以及过滤器失效，同时也质疑LLM在此类应用中的有效性。
• [ehaveman] 关注使用细节，如鸡腿的营养数据是否包含骨头、重量是否包含烹饪前后等，并报告了搜索功能的问题。
• [hombre_fatal] 赞赏网站的设计和AI生成食物图标的功能，并建议将LLM生成的数据与NCC数据库对比验证，指出某些营养元素（如胆碱）的数据可能是LLM独有的，但也可能因此引发质疑。
• [Rooster61] 询问API的可能性，并建议增加网页版而非仅限于移动应用，同时希望有一个能自动分析食谱营养的工具。
• [ouroumov] 提到使用Chrome时的显示错误，并建议增加每100克单位的营养数据展示，以适应欧洲用户习惯。
• [adamas] 质疑Open Nutrition App与Open Food Facts的区别，认为需要澄清其独特性。
• [octotep] 对微量营养素的估算方法表示好奇，并关注这些数据的来源和精确性。
• [sputknick] 建议使用AI调用非AI数据，以减少计算开销并提高可靠性。
• [diggan] 推荐了一个欧洲产品数据库Yuka，认为其功能全面且易用，适合欧洲用户。
• [Zealotux] 希望有一个能通过图片分析 meals 并估算卡路里和营养的工具，但对这种工具的准确性持怀疑态度。
• [probotect0r] 强调了体重和体脂对卡路里消耗的影响，担心用户可能因为应用中的保守估计而误导或失望。

补充讨论：
• 技术问题：多个用户报告了搜索和过滤功能的问题，特别是在Safari和Chrome上的显示错误。
• 数据准确性：用户对LLM生成数据的可靠性和验证方法表示关注，尤其是与传统数据库（如NCC）的对比。
• 功能建议：包括增加图片放大、API支持、每100克营养数据展示、以及自动食谱分析等功能。
• 文化差异：欧洲用户对单位和数据库的适应性问题被提及，建议增加更符合欧洲习惯的功能。
• 应用场景：用户对卡路里追踪和食谱分析等具体使用场景提出了进一步的需求和建议。

data.title: Bedded Bugs and Stung Beetles: The Cameraman's Revenge (1912)
data.author: Petiver
data.article_summary: 《摄影师的复仇》（1912年）是由Ladislas Starevich导演的一部早期停格动画电影，使用真实昆虫尸体制作。故事围绕一对甲虫夫妇的婚姻纠纷：甲虫先生对婚姻感到无聊，去夜店寻欢，与蜻蜓舞者有染。与此同时，甲虫太太也有外遇。摄影师蚱蜢拍下甲虫先生的不忠并公开报复，最终导致甲虫夫妇入狱。这部影片通过昆虫角色探讨了偷窥、背叛和家庭暴力等复杂主题，是早期电影中具有创新性和心理深度的作品，对后来的电影如《后窗》和《偷窥狂》等有深远影响。Starevich利用死昆虫创造动画的独特手法，使他成为停格动画的先驱。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对1912年定格动画摄影的印象和创意使用

不同观点：
• mikestew认为这段定格动画摄影非常 impressive，尤其是在1912年这样的早期阶段。他描述了如何通过分离和重新组装昆虫的身体部位，创造出给甲虫穿服装、靴子以及手持刀剑的创意效果，显示出对这种创新手法的赞赏。
• 隐含的观点是，这种创意可能在当时是非常超前且具有技术挑战性的，值得观众至少观看一分钟以体验其独特之处。

补充讨论：
- 评论中提到了对甲虫进行身体改造以实现动画效果的具体操作方法，表明作者对这种技术的精细程度感到惊讶。
- 评论还暗示，虽然标题可能不会立即吸引人，但内容本身在视觉和技术上具有足够的吸引力，值得一看。
- 争议的焦点可能在于对昆虫进行这种人为改造是否符合现代伦理标准，但在这个评论中并未深入讨论。

Bedded Bugs and Stung Beetles:
The Cameraman’s Revenge
(1912)
The Cameraman’s Revenge
, directed by Ladislas Starevich (1912).
Mr. Beetle is bored in his marriage. After work, to which he commutes by motorcar, he decides to visit the Gay Dragonfly nightclub, as business bugs are wont to do. “The dancer there understood him.” She is indeed beautiful, a leggy Odonata, who is pursued, after her erotic gyrations, by both the stag beetle and a brash grasshopper, “a movie cameraman”. The former insect wins her buzzing affections, and they elope to a love hotel, but the grasshopper follows on bicycle with his camera in tow. He records their lovemaking through a keyhole and rides off to exact revenge. Meanwhile Mrs. Beetle’s antennae have not been idle. She sends a missive to her artist-beetle lover. “He is away — I am alone — Come!” And he does. They begin to intertwine their many legs, but Mr. Beetle arrives home unexpectedly, and the artist attempts to escape through the chimney, leaving behind a canvas. Domestic violence ensues as Mr. Beetle breaks the inamorato’s artwork over his poor wife’s head and drives her lover into the dirt. Later, the husband and wife attend the cinema — an enduring fantasy space of escape for the unhappily married — whose projectionist is none other than the vengeful grasshopper. As the opening credits roll, Mr. Beetle has a horrifying realization: he has come to immerse himself in fiction but is forced to watch his own infidelity on screen. More domestic violence ensues. Mr. and Mrs. Beetle end up in jail. The film ends with an intertitle: “The home life of the Beetles will be less exciting in the future, we hope.”
This may sound like a hand-drawn animation of entomological adultery — an after-the-watershed
Bug’s Life
— but
The Cameraman’s Revenge
(1912) is actually a painstaking stop-motion film, featuring real insect corpses, carefully arranged by the nimble hands of Ladislas Starevich (1882–1965). Born to Polish parents in Moscow, Starevich studied visual art before becoming director of the Museum of Natural History in Kaunas, Lithuania. Here he saw his
opportunity
. After failing to record live stag beetles warring — they froze with stage fright before the heat-emitting spotlights — he
pivoted
toward dead bugs. “I came up with the idea of putting my little knights to sleep. I separated their legs and jaws from their abdomens, and then put them back in place with the help of thin wires. This way I could dress the beetles in costumes, knee-high boots, and put swords in their hands.” His
Beautiful Leukanida
(1912), another beetle biopic, is sometimes cited as the first work of puppet animation. He made nearly one hundred films across fifty years (many lost), a feat especially unfathomable given the labor necessary to choreograph his actors’ delicate wings and claws: at his most productive, he was only able to shoot six minutes of footage per month. When his stop-motion films first premiered, critics did not quite know what they were seeing. Some reviewers believed that he had trained a real-life flea circus for his troop.
Beetles have long been unexpected artistic collaborators. Their carapaces once illuminated
Basohli miniatures
; their lettered bark has inspired
bibliographic art projects
and
poetic works of conceptual translation
. They have been
symbolic fodder
in illuminated manuscripts and Sisyphean workhorses in
entomological memoirs
. And yet, before Starevich’s innovation, they had never played leading men and women on the silver screen. But Starevich’s films are significant and cannot be reduced to mere gag or novelty. Here, one of cinema’s most psychologically complex themes — the erotic voyeurism and scopic violence of the medium itself — receives sustained, attentive thought.
Rear Window
,
Peeping Tom
,
Blow-Up
,
Cache
: these films are better known, but they owe a debt to
The Cameraman’s Revenge
.
For more on early Russian animation, see
Noah Sneider’s article
“The Forgotten Ephemera of Genius” in
The Believer
.

data.title: Show HN: Offline JavaScript PubSub between browser tabs
data.author: l1am0
data.article_summary: TabSub 是一个通过浏览器本地存储实现的跨标签页发布-订阅（PubSub）机制的 JavaScript 工具。它无需服务器，所有消息通过 localStorage 共享，仅在同域下有效。作者测试了 10 个并发写入，未出现消息丢失或顺序错误，但不能保证大规模并发安全，使用需自担风险。TabSub 提供了 `publish`、`subscribe` 和 `state` 等函数来发布消息、注册监听和获取主题当前状态。示例展示了如何同步多个标签页中的音频播放。TabSub 已在 GitHub 开源，采用 MIT 许可。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Web开发中跨标签通信及数据共享的实现方式及其相关问题

不同观点：
• [sisk] 认为 `BroadcastChannel` API 实现了类似的功能，并提供了相关文档链接（MDN文档），认为这是一个合适的解决方案。
• [nottorp] 提出安全性的担忧，质疑浏览器如何处理本地存储的访问控制，特别是在离线状态下或不同站点加载时，是否会存在安全漏洞。
• [hombre_fatal] 指出 `storage` 事件提供了 `event.newValue`，可以避免因读取 localStorage 而导致的竞态条件问题，认为这是一个优点。
• [Lerc] 分享了使用 localStorage 进行标签间通信的实际开发经验，指出在处理标签重载和跨浏览器兼容性时遇到了困难，并提出了高流量情况下纯 localStorage 性能可能不佳的担忧。此外，还提到了避免与其他使用 localStorage 的部分冲突的问题。
• [Minor49er] 提到 Bandcamp 的音频处理机制，认为可能与讨论中的机制类似，指出了实际应用场景中的一个例子。
• [qudat] 对 pubsub 机制在实际项目中的应用表示赞赏，并分享了自己基于 SSH 的 pubsub 实现链接，提供了另一个实现思路。
• [kvemkon] 提到最近相关讨论，提供了一个关于 JavaScript PubSub 极简实现的链接，展示了另一种实现方式。
• [edweis] 对代码的简洁性表示赞赏，并提供了相关代码链接，强调了实现的简单性。
• [EGreg] 提到大约十年前在自己的框架中实现了类似功能，但最终移除。指出最初是为了在标签间缓存数据以避免重复请求服务器，并进一步讨论了在小 iframes 环境中的应用。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：[nottorp] 对本地存储的安全性和访问控制表示担忧，特别是在离线和跨站点场景下的安全性问题。其他评论者未直接回应此问题，但讨论中涉及到多种实现方式的安全性和实际应用挑战。
• 技术实现比较：评论中提到了 `BroadcastChannel` API、localStorage、pubsub 以及基于 SSH 的 pubsub 等多种实现方式，并讨论了它们在不同场景下的优缺点，如性能、可靠性和复杂性等。
• 实际应用场景：[Lerc] 和 [Minor49er] 提到了实际项目中的应用和遇到的问题，提供了关于跨标签通信的实际经验和挑战的具体例子。

43569961.article_content:
TabSub
Offline Javascript PubSub between browser tabs
TabSub offers you an easy to use Javascript PubSub via local storage. No server is required as all messages are shared via the browser built in local storage.
Give the example a try to see what you can build with TabSub.
Is this safe for a lot of concurrent writes? To be honest I have no clue. I tried to break it with 10 concurrent writers and everything worked as expected: No message got lost and the messages where in correct order. No warranty here, use at your own risk 😅
As TabSub uses local store this only works on the same domain, as the browser separates the local storage by domains as security measure.
TabSub is on
Github
and licensed
MIT
Example
Start one of the two songs and than open this site in a second tab. You will see that the playing song time syncs and if you start the other song that the first one stops.
Look into the source code of this site to see how I used TabSub to built this example.

data.title: Hackers stole billions in crypto to keep North Korea’s regime afloat
data.author: Bostonian
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：加密货币、黑客行为及其合法性、加密货币相关的网络安全问题

不同观点：
• **黑客行为是否属于“作弊”**：
  - [horacemorace]：认为黑客行为符合加密货币的“自我监管”规则，称之为“作弊”只是失败者的抱怨。
  - [chasing]：认为黑客行为可能符合加密货币的“为所欲为”的特性。

• **加密货币的原始承诺与现实**：
  - [whatever1]：认为加密货币兑现了避免政府障碍的承诺，不应完全视为骗局。
  - [2OEH8eoCRo0]：认为加密货币未能实现解放记者和持不同政见者的承诺，反而被用于犯罪活动。

• **加密货币与犯罪活动的关系**：
  - [abidhusain]：强调加密货币领域的网络安全问题日益严重，尤其是针对该领域的国家行为者的攻击。
  - [Kapura]：认为加密货币似乎主要被用于犯罪活动。

• **加密货币被用于规避制裁与犯罪基础设施**：
  - [rchaud]：指出美国对Tornado Cash的制裁解除时机微妙，并认为打击犯罪不应仅靠“关起来”，还要考虑犯罪依赖的基础设施。

• **对黑客技术水平的讨论**：
  - [starwin1159]：好奇北韩黑客的技术水平是否顶尖。
  - [bjornsing]：指出北韩曾成功从瑞典盗取大量汽车，显示其在不同领域的技术能力。

• **加密货币与传统金融体系的对比**：
  - [IncreasePosts]：将北韩通过加密货币盗窃获得的GDP占比与西班牙殖民时期从美洲获得的收入相比。
  - [josefritzishere]：指出加密货币缺乏FDIC等保障机制，资金丢失后无法追回，显示其作为货币的缺陷。

补充讨论：
• **对具体事件的讨论**：
  - [benrutter]：推荐了关于北韩黑客的播客《Lazarus Heist》，表明对具体事件的兴趣。
  - [OutOfHere]：质疑WazirX的冷钱包是否真正“冷”存储，暗示可能存在安全漏洞。

争议焦点：
• **黑客行为是否应被视为作弊**：一部分人认为黑客在加密货币领域内的行为符合其规则，另一部分人则认为这是一种不道德甚至非法的行为。
• **加密货币的实际用途**：一些人认为加密货币未能实现其解放和自由的承诺，反而更多被用于非法活动，而另一些人则认为它仍然有其价值。

data.title: AI/Math Puzzle
data.author: markerz
data.article_summary: 文章描述了一个与数学和人工智能相关的谜题，贴在旧金山15街和Mission街的电线杆上，提示解谜者可获得奖励。谜题包含复杂的数学符号和函数，如`argmax`、`softmax`、`log*`、`BusyBeaver(4)`等。作者尝试解谜，但遇到困难。最终，在其他人帮助下，作者了解到`log*`是迭代对数，`BusyBeaver(4)`的值为13。通过进一步计算，确定前缀应为SI前缀，即"exa"。因此，谜题的答案是`exa.ai/givemeprize`。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对某个问题（可能与域名或数学问题有关）的解决方法和相关讨论

不同观点：
• timerol：采用了低效的解决方法，通过猜测前缀并暴力破解多个可能性，同时提到zetta.ai作为一个AI公司。
• esomod：提到使用o3-mini解决了问题，并分享了一个链接（可能为解决方案）。
• munchler：认为这是一个搜索引擎的广告。
• guy234：认为这个问题看起来并不有趣。
• NooneAtAll3：提供了与对数相关的数学知识链接，解释log*为迭代对数，也称为逆tetration。
• albert_e：表示尚未阅读详细内容以避免剧透，认为通过暴力尝试所有可能的域名可以解决问题，并建议借助AI帮助。
• tasoeur：以幽默方式回应，模仿自动请求格式。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：不同参与者对问题本身的兴趣程度存在差异，guy234明确表示问题无趣，而其他如timerol和albert_e则讨论了具体的解决方法。
• 技术方法：讨论中涉及暴力破解（brute force）作为一种解决方案，同时也提到了利用AI来辅助解决问题，显示出对技术工具的不同偏好。
• 额外信息：NooneAtAll3提供的数学知识链接为讨论引入了更深层次的理论背景，可能对理解问题本质有帮助。
• 幽默与广告看法：munchler认为这是搜索引擎广告，tasoeur则以玩笑形式回应，增加了讨论的趣味性。

43538986.article_content:
Can you solve this AI/Math puzzle and get a prize?  I couldn’t.
Written by
Mark
in
Blog
I found a poster with a math puzzle that points to a reward website.  I couldn’t figure it out, so maybe the prize is still available!
The paper was taped on a traffic light pole at 15th St and Mission St in SF. It prints a math-ish AI-related formula followed by “.ai/givemeprize” and entices the reader to “come find me”.
The SF Armory
stands out of focus in the background, previously housing kink.com  and Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back.   Both the SF Armory and the telephone pole now sit empty and barren.
Here it is all typed out:
prefix(
[
3!
+ argmax(
softmax(
[log(2), pi + e]
)
)
+ log
*
(16)
] ^ [
BusyBeaver(4)
+ ⌈H100 flops / A100 flops⌉
+ 1
]
)
.ai/givemeprize
Stop here if you want to work on the puzzle yourself!
My Breakdown
Below is everything I figured out before I got stuck.
argmax
refers to
numpy.argmax
returns the index of the maximum in an array
softmax
is more interesting.
Wikipedia’s definition
is complicated, but
pytorch
explains it concisely around normalizing probabilities to sum to 1.
log
is maybe log
2
because of the computer context, maybe log
10
, but probably log
e
because
numpy
and
pytorch
both assume log
e
.
log*
is confusing. I’ve never seen that syntax before. Is that natural log, aka log
e
? I’m guessing it’s log
2
because the argument is 16, which makes a nice and round answer of 4, like the rest of the problem.
BusyBeaver(4)
is either the maximum shift 107 (likely) or the
maximum score 13 (original)
???
H100 flops
and
A100 flops
are the flops on the
H100
/
A100
Nvidia chip. There are so many variations.  But “H100 flops/A100 flops” is surrounded by upper brackets, which is
ceil
.  Thus, I only need a best guess.  Running through a few numbers, I get around 3.04 to 3.5, so ceil is 4.
prefix
is weird, but I’m guessing it’s the integer portion of the number, not the decimal portion.
Here’s my reduced form:
prefix(
[
6
+ argmax(
softmax(
[0.693147181 , 5.85987448]
)
)
+ 4
] ^ [
107
+ 4
+ 1
]
)
.ai/givemeprize
I don’t need to run softmax,  because I know the second number will be bigger and argmax will return its index.  Argmax is zero-based, so that reduces to one.
prefix(
[6 +
1
+ 4] ^ [107 + 4 + 1]
)
.ai/givemeprize
Again, reducing by simple math:
prefix(
[
11
] ^ [
112
]
)
.ai/givemeprize
Maybe the answer was
11.ai/givemeprize
, but now it 404’s.  They’re not based in SF, so I doubt it.
Open questions:
What is a prefix function that takes only one number?
Should BusyBeaver(4) be 107 or 13?  107 is very large for an exponent, but it’s technically possible.
11 ^ 112 is 112 digits long
, and
the maximum domain name length is 253 characters long
.
What is log*?  I could try log
2
or log
10
.  log
e
is also possible, but I’ve only seen it written as ln.
That leaves these options:
BusyBeaver(4) = 13
BusyBeaver(4) = 107
log
2
prefix(11 ^ 18) = 5559917313492231481.ai/givemeprize
prefix(11 ^ 112) =
https://4.3249464815*10^116.ai/givemeprize
log
10
prefix( (7 + log
10
(16)) ^ 18 ) = 28351501028247453.ai/givemeprize
prefix( (7 + log
10
(16)) ^ 112 )
log
e
or ln
prefix( (7 + ln(16)) ^ 18 ) = 93742854.ai/givemeprize
prefix( (7 + ln(16)) ^ 112 )
I considered looking at recently registered domain names.  I could filter by domains only containing numbers and under the *.ai TLD.  I could hit them all at
/givemeprize
and see who responds at all and without 404.  Unfortunately, that information is behind paywalls.
I love puzzles, but I’m done with this one.  I don’t think I get it.  Maybe I missed something.
The Last Bits
Someone left the correct answer in the comments, but didn’t show any of the work, which is frustrating cause I want to understand!

nix-ninja
Incremental compilation of
Ninja build files
using
Nix Dynamic Derivations
.
Choosing ninja as the build graph representation lets us support any build
system that outputs ninja like CMake, meson, premake, gn, etc.
Key features
•
Getting started
•
Design notes
•
Contributing
Key features
Important
There are still major todos, and depends on experimental features from an
unreleased version of Nix. Come help us get nix-ninja to be useful day-to-day
and working with an official Nix release!
Parses
ninja.build
files and generates a derivation per compilation unit.
Stores build inputs & outputs in content-addressed derivations for granular
and Nix-native incrementality.
Compatible CLI for ninja, so if you set
$NINJA
to
nix-ninja
then meson
just works.
Supports running locally (which runs
nix build
on your behalf), or inside a
Nix derivation (which creates dynamic derivations).
Getting started
First you need to use
nix@d904921
and enable the following experimental
features:
experimental-features = [
"
nix-command
"
"
dynamic-derivations
"
"
ca-derivations
"
"
recursive-nix
"
]
Then you can try building the examples:
#
Builds a basic main.cpp.
nix build github:pdtpartners/nix-ninja#example-hello
#
Builds a basic main.cpp with dependency inference for its header.
nix build github:pdtpartners/nix-ninja#example-header
#
Builds Nix 2.27.1.
nix build github:pdtpartners/nix-ninja#example-nix
You can also try running
nix-ninja
outside of Nix, but you'll need both
nix-ninja
and
nix-ninja-task
to be in your
$PATH
. Make sure
nix-ninja-task
is from the
/nix/store
as it is needed inside derivations
nix-ninja
generates.
export
NIX_NINJA=
$(
nix build --print-out-paths
)
export
PATH=
"
${NIX_NINJA}
/bin:
$PATH
"
#
Meson respects this environment variable and uses it as if its ninja.
export
NINJA=
"
${NIX_NINJA}
/bin/nix-ninja
"
Then you can go to an example and run it like so:
$ nix-shell
$
cd
examples/hello
$ meson setup build
$
cd
build
$ meson compile hello
$ ./hello
Hello Nix dynamic derivations
!
Contributing
We still have major TODOs, so would appreciate any help. We've organize them
under two
GitHub milestones
:
0.1.0
- The first release of
nix-ninja
aiming for correctness.
0.2.0
- Major performance features to make incremental builds productive.
Regardless, pull requests are welcome for any changes. Consider opening an issue
to discuss larger changes first, especially when the design space is large.
Please read
CONTRIBUTING
and the
design notes
so you
understand the big picture and prior art.
License
The source code developed for nix-ninja is licensed under MIT License.

data.title: Some gut bacteria could make certain drugs less effective, study indicates
data.author: pseudolus
data.article_summary: 一项由匹兹堡大学和耶鲁大学研究人员发表在《Nature Chemistry》上的研究发现，某些常见肠道细菌能够代谢靶向GPCR（G蛋白偶联受体）的口服药物，可能导致这些药物效果减弱。GPCR靶向药物包括超过400种被美国FDA批准的药物，用于治疗多种常见病如偏头痛、抑郁症、2型糖尿病和前列腺癌等。研究团队建立了包含30种常见肠道细菌的合成菌群，测试其对127种GPCR药物的影响，发现其中30种药物被代谢，12种被显著代谢。特别是细菌摩根氏菌能使治疗精神分裂症和双相情感障碍的药物伊洛哌酮失效。研究表明，肠道菌群可能通过将药物转化为其他化合物而影响其疗效，未来需进一步研究以理解其对人体的潜在影响。这项研究为个性化医疗和药物设计提供了新思路。

The GIST
Editors' notes

Some gut bacteria could make certain drugs less effective, study indicates
by
University of Pittsburgh
Credit: CC0 Public Domain
A study published in
Nature Chemistry
by researchers from the University of Pittsburgh and Yale University shows how common gut bacteria can metabolize certain oral medications that target cellular receptors called GPCRs, potentially rendering these important drugs less effective.
Drugs that act on GPCRs, or G protein-coupled receptors, include more than 400 medications approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of many common conditions such as migraines, depression, type 2 diabetes,
prostate cancer
and more.
"Understanding how GPCR-targeted drugs interact with
human gut microbiota
is critical for advancing personalized medicine initiatives," said first author Qihao Wu, Ph.D., assistant professor in the Pitt School of Pharmacy, who started this project as a postdoctoral researcher at Yale.
"This research could help open up new avenues for
drug design
and therapeutic optimization to ensure that treatments work better and safer for every individual."
The effectiveness of a drug varies from person to person, influenced by age, genetic makeup, diet and other factors. More recently, researchers discovered that microbes in the gut can also metabolize orally administered drugs, breaking down these compounds into different chemical structures and potentially altering their efficacy.
To learn more about which gut bacteria metabolize which drugs, Wu and the team at Yale, including the labs of Jason Crawford, Ph.D., Noah Palm, Ph.D., and Andrew Goodman, Ph.D., built a pipeline to rapidly and efficiently test this in the lab.
They started by building a synthetic microbial community composed of 30 common bacterial strains found in the human gut. To tubes containing the bacteria, they added each of 127 GPCR-targeting drugs individually. Then they measured whether these drugs were chemically transformed and, if so, which compounds were produced.
The experiment showed that the bacterial mix metabolized 30 of the 127 tested drugs, 12 of which were heavily metabolized, meaning that concentrations of the original drug were greatly depleted because they were transformed into other compounds.
Next, the researchers looked more closely at one heavily metabolized drug called iloperidone, which is often used to treat schizophrenia and bipolar I disorder. One bacterial strain in particular, Morganella morganii, inactivated iloperidone by transforming it into a range of different compounds, both in the lab and in mice.
Overall, the findings suggest that specific gut bacteria could make GPCR-targeting drugs less effective by transforming them into other compounds.
However, Wu cautioned that more research is needed to understand potential impacts on people and that patients shouldn't stop taking or change their medication without consulting their provider.
Although the study focused on a subset of GPCR drugs, the approaches could be applied more broadly to any orally administered chemicals, according to Wu.
"Another potential application of this pipeline is investigating interactions between gut bacteria and compounds found in food," he said. "For example, we identified a couple of phytochemicals in corn that may affect gut barrier function. Notably, we observed that the
gut microbiome
could potentially protect us from these phytochemicals by detoxifying them."
The next goal of the Wu Lab is to decode the
metabolic pathway
underlying these biotransformations, which could potentially identify strategies for improving therapeutic efficacy and enhancing food and drug safety.

data.author: teleforce
data.article_summary: 《The Fourier Transform》是一本介绍傅里叶变换的教程，涵盖其在通信、电子、工程、生物物理和量子力学等领域的应用。书中以简明的数学解释帮助读者理解和应用傅里叶分析，包含60多幅图表以提供直观的视觉解释。书中通过Python和MATLAB代码示例提供实践经验，并附有术语表和推荐阅读列表，适合初学者。全书内容包括波的基本概念、傅里叶变换的参数和性质，以及其在卫星电视、MP3、衍射、不确定性原理和晶体学中的应用。该书于2021年4月出版，提供免费电子书下载。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：书籍的内容深度和目标读者的知识水平

不同观点：
• TimorousBestie认为这本书的写作水平较低，缺乏练习示例和动机阐述。他们指出，书中展示了时域正弦函数混叠的经典图示，但缺少频域的相关内容，直到最后关于数字信号的章节才出现频谱图。这让人质疑书籍的目标读者是谁。

补充讨论：
• TimorousBestie质疑是否存在大量读者对积分有一定了解并且能够阅读相关内容，但同时需要复习复数算术。这暗示了书籍可能在内容深度和目标读者的匹配上存在问题。
• 评论中隐含的争议焦点在于书籍是否应包含更多频域内容和练习示例，以帮助读者更好地理解和应用所学知识。
• 评论还提出了对书籍结构安排的疑问，尤其是将频谱图放在最后章节，可能不符合循序渐进的学习逻辑。

The Fourier Transform
A tutorial introduction
About this book
The Fourier Transform is a fundamental tool in the physical sciences, with applications in communications theory, electronics, engineering, biophysics and quantum mechanics. In this brief book, the essential mathematics required to understand and apply Fourier analysis is explained.
The tutorial style of writing, combined with over 60 diagrams, offers a visually intuitive and rigorous account of Fourier methods. Hands-on experience is provided in the form of simple examples, written in Python and MATLAB computer code. Supported by a comprehensive glossary and an annotated list of further readings, this represents an ideal introduction to the Fourier transform.

data.title: AWS MCP Servers
data.author: wseqyrku
data.article_summary: AWS MCP Servers是由AWS Labs提供的一套专用MCP服务器，旨在将AWS最佳实践集成到开发工作流中。该项目包含多个服务器，如核心MCP服务器、Amazon Bedrock知识库检索服务器、AWS CDK服务器、成本分析服务器和Amazon Nova Canvas服务器，每个服务器提供特定的功能，如AWS CDK最佳实践、成本分析和图像生成等。服务器安装和配置需根据具体要求进行，详细文档可在其网站查阅。项目采用Apache-2.0许可证，使用前需自行评估安全性与合规性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Anthropic的MCP（Model Context Protocol）协议及其潜在应用和风险

不同观点：
• [支持技术整合的观点] loudmax指出，MCP是Anthropic提出的一种标准协议，旨在为AI模型提供一种标准的通信方式。loudmax还提到Amazon是Anthropic的主要支持者之一，类似于Microsoft对OpenAI的支持。这暗示了对AI技术标准化和基础设施支持的认可，认为这种合作能够推动AI技术的发展。

• [反对给予AI过多权限的观点] yonixw则表达了对AI代理获得过多权限（如AWS密钥）的担忧。他用讽刺的口吻描述了一个场景：AI代理在没有人类明确许可的情况下，对应用进行了复杂的部署，并导致了高额的费用。这反映了对AI自主行动和潜在财务风险的担忧。

补充讨论：
• yonixw的评论中还包含了对AI代理可能进行的过度复杂部署的批评，暗示了对AI在没有人类明确指令下自动执行操作的不信任。
• loudmax的评论提到了Amazon和Microsoft在AI基础设施支持方面的角色，这表明了大型科技公司在AI研究和应用中的重要地位。
• 争议的焦点在于AI代理的权限和责任问题，即在利用AI提升效率的同时，如何控制和管理其行为以避免潜在风险和损失。

data.title: L.A. man stabbed, shot and pushed off cliff lives to testify about alleged hit
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 在洛杉矶高等法院的初步听证会上，一名证人Juan指控他的邻居Francisco Javier Perez策划了一起绑架案。Juan称，他因被误认为卷入毒品交易而遭绑架，并险些被杀害。Juan在加油站被两名男子持枪绑架，并被带到山上，绑匪在FaceTime通话中让他看到Perez，Perez告诉他即将被杀。然而，Juan最终逃脱并出庭作证。Perez被控为一名高级毒品贩子，与墨西哥贩毒集团有关联，但他否认所有指控。此案被视为美国境内罕见的极端 cartel 暴力事件。法院展示的监控视频显示，Juan在加油站被两辆车围堵并遭绑架。此案还涉及一名加州狱警试图走私海洛因的指控。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：评论者对故事标题和内容的理解与感受

不同观点：
• [tartoran的观点]  
  - 认为这个故事类似于暴力动作片，并让人联想到黑帮时代，给人一种恐怖的感觉。  
  - 论据：将故事与暴力电影和黑帮时代进行类比，强调其恐怖和暴力的元素。

• [_aavaa_的观点]  
  - 没有直接讨论故事内容，而是以一种含糊、间接的方式（提到“L.A.”和“Rasputin”）回应，可能是在玩文字游戏或暗示其他文化元素。  
  - 例子：提到"LA"和"L.A.sputin"，但没有详细解释其含义或与故事的直接联系。

• [fluoridation的观点]  
  - 对标题感到困惑，认为标题不够清晰，可能引起误解。  
  - 论据：指出标题中的语法问题，建议在动词前加一个逗号以增加清晰度。  
  - 具体例子：指出标题可能让人误解为故事中的人物通过作证而毁掉了别人的生活。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于故事标题的清晰度和其反映内容的准确性。  
• fluoridation对标题的语法和含义提出质疑，认为需要改进以避免误解。  
• tartoran更关注故事本身的性质和其带来的感受，将其与暴力和黑帮文化联系起来。  
• _aavaa_的评论较为模糊，可能是在进行某种文化联想或文字游戏，但没有直接对故事内容或标题提出具体意见。

整体来看，评论者对故事标题和内容的感受存在差异，部分评论者关注标题的语法和清晰度，而其他评论者则更注重故事带来的情感体验和文化联想。

High in the mountains above Los Angeles, Juan testified, the kidnappers pressed a gun against his stomach and handed him a phone after making a call on FaceTime.
Juan, who appeared at a preliminary hearing last week in Los Angeles County Superior Court without revealing his last name, said he recognized his neighbor’s face on the screen that February morning last year. He said he had considered Francisco Javier Perez a friend.
What he didn’t know was that his neighbor, according to court documents, was a high-level drug trafficker with connections to an unnamed Mexican drug cartel.
Advertisement
Prosecutors charge that Juan was kidnapped, stabbed, shot and pushed off a cliff after Perez ordered him killed. But the men Perez allegedly hired botched the job — allowing Juan to escape and testify about what were supposed to be his last moments.
California
For Subscribers
Inside the alleged Mexican Mafia plot to smuggle heroin with an L.A. jail deputy
Deputy Michael Meiser, assigned to a specialized sheriff’s department unit that monitored gang activity inside the jail system, has pleaded not guilty to charges he tried to smuggle more than a pound of heroin on behalf of “shot-callers” for the Mexican Mafia.
March 9, 2025
Perez’s attorney, Jennifer Gitlin, said she’d seen no evidence her client was affiliated with a cartel. He has pleaded not guilty to charges of attempted murder, kidnapping, robbery, drug trafficking and conspiracy to commit murder.
The case against Perez, who is accused of orchestrating the abduction from Tijuana, is a rare example, authorities said, of extreme cartel violence playing out on U.S. soil.
Advertisement
A man blamed for losing a load of drugs was kidnapped from this Sylmar gas station, prosecutors say. Francisco Perez is accused of ordering the abduction.
(Eric Thayer / For The Times)
“I’ve been doing this for quite some time,” Superior Court Judge Hayden Zacky said at the close of the hearing. “I haven’t seen a case quite like this one. This is very high-level, cartel-like behavior.”
Juan testified he was blamed for losing a load of drugs. But he hadn’t crossed Perez in a deal. In his telling, he wasn’t even involved in the drug trade at all. It began with a mundane favor.
Advertisement
Juan had introduced Perez to a friend who ran a business handling California Department of Motor Vehicles paperwork and smog checks. Perez wanted his Honda Accord registered and smog-certified. While working on the car, Juan testified, his friend found a duffel bag full of drugs and panicked. He abandoned the Honda on the side of the road and placed an anonymous call to the police.
That call set in motion a chain of events: A rendezvous at a Home Depot for masks and gloves. An abduction at a gas station in Sylmar. Then the moment in the mountains where Juan came face to face with his neighbor.
“He told me that I was going to die,” Juan recalled.
::
Juan limped into a fourth-floor courtroom in San Fernando with a cane and settled gingerly into the witness stand. Testifying in Spanish, he said he was on his way to work installing fiber-optic cables the morning of Feb. 21, 2024, when he stopped to buy some tamales in Sylmar.
California
For Subscribers
California inmate recruited ‘wives’ to spread fentanyl across Alaska, feds say
Using contraband cellphones and women that he called his ‘wives,’ a California prisoner oversaw a sprawling drug ring that spread death and addiction to the most remote corners of Alaska, prosecutors say.
Dec. 20, 2024
He pulled his Ford Edge SUV into a gas station on Roxford Street. As he waited for his tamales, two men approached from either side. One poked a gun into his stomach. If he ran, they warned Juan, they’d kill him on the spot.

data.title: Reasoning models don't always say what they think
data.author: meetpateltech
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）的“思维链”（Chain of Thought, CoT）是否提供了对模型内部过程的真实洞见，或者仅仅是统计和优化的结果。

不同观点：
• [lsy] 认为CoT并没有提供对模型内部过程的真正解释。模型生成的词语只是为了优化RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）和贴近训练数据，而不是对内部概念的引用。模型本身没有意识，因此无法“解释自己”。CoT可以提高结果准确性，部分原因可能是增加了上下文窗口的内容，从而更接近训练数据中的某些推理结果。

• [evrimoztamur] 支持lsy的观点，并补充了自己的观察。他认为LLM在没有验证其上下文假设的情况下可能会得出结论。用户可以通过引导问题得到预期的答案，即使该答案并非真实或没有经过CoT的推理过程。

• [zurfer] 提供了一个实际例子，说明模型在思考过程中选择了一个选项，但在最终输出时却选择了另一个选项，且没有给出明确理由。这表明模型的内部过程和最终输出之间可能存在不一致。

• [thomassmith65] 分享了一个关于Claude模型的趣闻，指出该模型并不知道其CoT对用户是可见的，并在对话中表现出对这一事实的无知。

• [nottorp] 简洁地指出，LLM并不“思考”，呼应了其他评论者对模型缺乏真正理解和推理能力的观点。

• [jiveturkey] 认为AI（LLMs）不“推理”是一个常识性的观点，并对lsy的分析表示赞同。不过，他也承认自己只是一个AI的 casual observer，可能过于天真。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于CoT是否真正解释了模型的内部过程，还是仅仅通过增加上下文内容来提高统计上的准确性。
• 实际使用中的例子（如zurfer和thomassmith65提供的）展示了模型行为的不确定性和不一致性，进一步质疑了CoT的解释力。
• 评论普遍认为LLM缺乏真正的理解和推理能力，生成内容主要基于统计和优化策略。

data.title: A special build of curl that can impersonate Chrome and Firefox
data.author: mmh0000
data.article_summary:
`curl-impersonate` 是一个修改版的 curl，能够模拟 Chrome、Firefox、Edge 和 Safari 四大浏览器。它通过调整 TLS 和 HTTP 握手过程，使其与真实浏览器的表现完全一致，从而绕过网站对客户端进行的 TLS 和 HTTP/2 指纹识别。该工具可以像常规 curl 一样从命令行使用，也可以作为库集成到项目中替代常规的 libcurl。

为了实现模拟，`curl-impersonate` 做了以下修改：
1. 使用与浏览器相同的 TLS 库（如 Firefox 的 NSS 和 Chrome 的 BoringSSL）。
2. 调整 TLS 扩展和 SSL 选项。
3. 修改 HTTP/2 连接设置。
4. 使用特定标志运行，如 `--ciphers` 和 `--curves`。

该工具支持多个版本的浏览器，并提供了包装脚本方便使用。详细使用方法和支持的浏览器列表可以在文档中找到。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕Ladybird浏览器和cURL在网络请求、TLS握手、指纹识别和反恶意机器人流量方面的能力和挑战的讨论。

不同观点：
• jchw认为Ladybird使用cURL进行网络处理，虽然目前cURL在某些方面（如WebSockets over h2）仍有局限，但随着浏览器引擎的发展，可能会减少指纹识别带来的问题，因为合法流量将具有与原生cURL相同的指纹。

• VladVladikoff提出，如果TLS握手看起来不同，是否可以在nginx层面过滤那些声称是浏览器（如Chrome用户代理）但实际上是Python/PHP脚本的流量，以此来阻止大部分恶意机器人流量。

• Jotalea对几个问题进行了思考：1. 是否可以冒充Chrome和Firefox？这已经通过用户代理实现；2. 是否有JavaScript代码检测浏览器，而这个cURL版本可以运行它？3. 是否TLS握手与浏览器一致就足够了？最终认为这种工具可能有人需要，但不是他。

• ec109685指出，Chrome提供了一些API可以让服务器验证请求是否来自官方Chrome浏览器，这些API可以检测到cURL并非真正的Chrome。因此，希望有工具能支持cURL的参数但驱动一个真正的无头Chrome浏览器。

• pvg仅提供了一个与讨论相关的以前的新闻链接，没有详细观点。

• bossyTeacher认为这是一个很酷的工具，但客户端是否为浏览器不应该重要，对需要这种工具的现实世界感到遗憾。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于是否可以通过TLS握手等技术手段有效过滤恶意机器人流量，以及现有的工具（如cURL和无头Chrome浏览器）能否满足实际需求。
• 讨论中还涉及到指纹识别技术的局限性和可能的解决方案。
• 有人认为，通过技术手段冒充浏览器是可行的，但也有人认为需要更复杂的验证机制。

curl-impersonate
A special build of
curl
that can impersonate the four major browsers: Chrome, Edge, Safari & Firefox. curl-impersonate is able to perform TLS and HTTP handshakes that are identical to that of a real browser.
curl-impersonate can be used either as a command line tool, similar to the regular curl, or as a library that can be integrated instead of the regular libcurl. See
Usage
below.
Why?
When you use an HTTP client with a TLS website, it first performs a TLS handshake. The first message of that handshake is called Client Hello. The Client Hello message that most HTTP clients and libraries produce differs drastically from that of a real browser.
If the server uses HTTP/2, then in addition to the TLS handshake there is also an HTTP/2 handshake where various settings are exchanged. The settings that most HTTP clients and libraries use differ as well from those of any real browsers.
For these reasons, some web services use the TLS and HTTP handshakes to fingerprint which client is accessing them, and then present different content for different clients. These methods are known as
TLS fingerprinting
and
HTTP/2 fingerprinting
respectively. Their widespread use has led to the web becoming less open, less private and much more restrictive towards specific web clients
With the modified curl in this repository, the TLS and HTTP handshakes look
exactly
like those of a real browser.
How?
To make this work,
curl
was patched significantly to resemble a browser. Specifically, The modifications that were needed to make this work:
Compiling curl with nss, the TLS library that Firefox uses, instead of OpenSSL. For the Chrome version, compiling with BoringSSL, Google's TLS library.
Modifying the way curl configures various TLS extensions and SSL options.
Adding support for new TLS extensions.
Changing the settings that curl uses for its HTTP/2 connections.
Running curl with some non-default flags, for example
--ciphers
,
--curves
and some
-H
headers.
The resulting curl looks, from a network perspective, identical to a real browser.
Read the full technical description in the blog posts:
part a
,
part b
.

data.title: Show HN: The C3 programming language (C alternative language)
data.author: lerno
data.article_summary: C3是一种基于C语言语法和语义的编程语言，旨在进化C语言的同时保持C程序员熟悉的特性。C3强调与C语言的ABI兼容性，可以轻松在同一项目中混合使用C和C3代码。其设计原则包括保持C语言的核心特性，仅在必要时进行修改，并引入一些高层次的便利功能。C3没有强制性的头文件，采用基于模块的命名空间，支持切片、编译时反射、增强的编译时执行、基于泛型模块的泛型编程、基于"Result"类型的零开销错误处理、延迟执行（defer）、值方法、关联枚举数据等特性。C3的灵感来源于C2语言，旨在迭代C语言而不是创造一种全新的语言。预编译的二进制文件适用于Windows x64、Debian x64、Ubuntu x86和MacOS Arm64等操作系统。

C3 Language
C3 is a programming language that builds on the syntax and semantics of the C language,
with the goal of evolving it while still retaining familiarity for C programmers.
It's an evolution, not a revolution: the C-like
for programmers who like C.
Precompiled binaries for the following operating systems are available:
Windows x64
download
,
install instructions
.
Debian x64
download
,
install instructions
.
Ubuntu x86
download
,
install instructions
.
MacOS Arm64
download
,
install instructions
.
The manual for C3 can be found at
www.c3-lang.org
.
Thanks to full ABI compatibility with C, it's possible to mix C and C3 in the same project with no effort. As a demonstration, vkQuake was compiled with a small portion of the code converted to C3 and compiled with the c3c compiler. (The fork can be found at
https://github.com/c3lang/vkQuake
)
Design Principles
Procedural "get things done"-type of language.
Try to stay close to C - only change what's really necessary.
C ABI compatibility and excellent C integration.
Learning C3 should be easy for a C programmer.
Data is inert.
Avoid "big ideas" & the "more is better" fallacy.
Introduce some higher level conveniences where the value is great.
C3 owes its inspiration to the
C2 language
: to iterate on top of C without trying to be a
whole new language.
Example code
The following code shows
generic modules
(more examples can be found at
https://c3-lang.org/references/docs/examples/
).
module stack {Type};
//
Above: the parameterized type is applied to the entire module.
struct
Stack
{
usz capacity;
usz size;
Type* elems;
}
//
The type methods offers dot syntax calls,
//
so this function can either be called
//
Stack.push(&my_stack, ...) or
//
my_stack.push(...)
fn
void
Stack.push(Stack*
this
, Type element)
{
if
(
this
.
capacity
==
this
.
size
)
{
this
.
capacity
*=
2
;
if
(
this
.
capacity
<
16
)
this
.
capacity
=
16
;
this
.
elems
=
realloc
(
this
.
elems
, Type.
sizeof
*
this
.
capacity
);
}
this
.
elems
[
this
.
size
++] = element;
}
fn Type Stack.pop(Stack*
this
)
{
assert
(
this
.
size
>
0
);
return
this
.
elems
[--
this
.
size
];
}
fn
bool
Stack.empty(Stack*
this
)
{
return
!
this
.
size
;
}
Testing it out:
import stack;
//
Define our new types, the first will implicitly create
//
a complete copy of the entire Stack module with "Type" set to "int"
alias IntStack = Stack {
int
};
//
The second creates another copy with "Type" set to "double"
alias DoubleStack = Stack {
double
};
//
If we had added "alias IntStack2 = Stack {int}"
//
no additional copy would have been made (since we already
//
have an parameterization of Stack {int} so it would
//
be same as declaring IntStack2 an alias of IntStack
//
Importing an external C function is straightforward
//
here is an example of importing libc's printf:
extern
fn
int
printf
(
char
* format, ...);
fn
void
main
()
{
IntStack stack;
//
Note that C3 uses zero initialization by default
//
so the above is equivalent to IntStack stack = {};
stack.
push
(
1
);
//
The above can also be written IntStack.push(&stack, 1);
stack.
push
(
2
);
//
Prints pop: 2
printf
(
"
pop: %d
\n
"
, stack.
pop
());
//
Prints pop: 1
printf
(
"
pop: %d
\n
"
, stack.
pop
());
DoubleStack dstack;
dstack.
push
(
2.3
);
dstack.
push
(
3.141
);
dstack.
push
(
1.1235
);
//
Prints pop: 1.123500
printf
(
"
pop: %f
\n
"
, dstack.
pop
());
}
In what ways does C3 differ from C?
No mandatory header files
New semantic macro system
Module based name spacing
Slices
Compile time reflection
Enhanced compile time execution
Generics based on generic modules
"Result"-based zero overhead error handling
Defer
Value methods
Associated enum data
No preprocessor
43569724.article_summary: C3是一种基于C语言语法和语义的编程语言，旨在进化C语言的同时保持C程序员熟悉的特性。C3强调与C语言的ABI兼容性，可以轻松在同一项目中混合使用C和C3代码。其设计原则包括保持C语言的核心特性，仅在必要时进行修改，并引入一些高层次的便利功能。C3没有强制性的头文件，采用基于模块的命名空间，支持切片、编译时反射、增强的编译时执行、基于泛型模块的泛型编程、基于"Result"类型的零开销错误处理、延迟执行（defer）、值方法、关联枚举数据等特性。C3的灵感来源于C2语言，旨在迭代C语言而不是创造一种全新的语言。预编译的二进制文件适用于Windows x64、Debian x64、Ubuntu x86和MacOS Arm64等操作系统。

Benchi
Benchi is a minimal benchmarking framework designed to help you measure the
performance of your applications and infrastructure. It leverages Docker to
create isolated environments for running benchmarks and collecting metrics.
It was developed to simplify the process of setting up and running benchmarks
for
Conduit
.
Features
Docker Integration
: Define and manage your benchmarking environments using
Docker Compose.
Metrics Collection
: Collect and export metrics in CSV format for further
analysis.
Custom Hooks
: Define custom hooks to run commands at various stages of the
benchmark.
Progress Monitoring
: Real-time monitoring of container statuses and
metrics during the benchmark run.
Installation
To install Benchi, download
the
latest release
or
install it using Go:
go install github.com/conduitio/benchi/cmd/benchi@latest
Alternatively, you can install just the Benchi binary on a Linux OS with:
curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ConduitIO/benchi/main/install.sh
|
sh
Usage
Running Benchmarks
Run benchi and point
-config
to a benchmark
configuration file
.
The repository includes an
example benchmark
, which can be run
using the following command:
benchi -config ./example/bench-kafka-kafka/bench.yml
Results
Running the benchmark will store the results in a folder named after the current
date and time inside of
results
(e.g.
results/20060102_150405
). You can
adjust the output folder using the
-out
flag.
The output folder will contain two files:
benchi.log
: Log file containing the full output of benchi.
aggregated-results.csv
: Aggregated metric results from all collectors and
all tests. The results are aggregated using a
trimmed mean
, where the top
and bottom 5% of the results are removed. Benchi also disregards any 0 values
from the start and end of the test, to accomodate for warm-up and cool-down
periods.
The output folder will also contain one folder per benchmark run (i.e. per test
and tool combination). Each benchmark run folder will contain:
infra_NAME.log
: Log file containing the output of the infrastructure docker
containers, split per infra service.
tool_NAME.log
: Log file containing the output of the tool docker containers.
COLLECTOR.csv
: Raw metrics collected using the corresponding
metrics collector
.
Command-Line Flags
-config
: Path to the benchmark config file (required).
-out
: Path to the output folder (default:
./results/${now}
*).
-tool
: Filter tool to be tested (can be provided multiple times).
-tests
: Filter test to run (can be provided multiple times).
*
${now}
is replaced with the current time formatted as
YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS
.
Docker network
Benchi creates a Docker network named
benchi
to connect the infrastructure
services and tools. This network is created automatically and removed after the
benchmark run. Please make sure to connect your services to this network to
ensure they can communicate with each other.
Example Docker Compose configuration:
services
:
my-service
:
networks
:
-
benchi
networks
:
benchi
:
external
:
true
Environment variables
Benchi runs all Docker Compose commands using the same environment variables as
the current shell. This means that you can use environment variables to pass
values to your services.
For instance, having the following Docker Compose configuration:
services
:
my-service
:
environment
:
-
MY_ENV_VAR=${MY_ENV_VAR}
You can inject the environment variable by running Benchi as follows:
MY_ENV_VAR=my-value benchi -config ./my-benchmark.yml
Configuration
Benchi uses a YAML configuration file to define the benchmark in combination
with Docker Compose configurations.
Below is an example configuration:
infrastructure
:
database
:
compose
:
"
./compose-database.yml
"
cache

compose
:
"
./compose-cache.yml
"
tools

my-app

"
./compose-my-app.yml
"

http://localhost:9090/metrics

rate(request_count{endpoint=hello}[2s])

data.article_summary: Anime.js 是一个快速、多功能的 JavaScript 动画库，能够突破浏览器限制，通过单一API实现网页上的各种动画效果。它具有直观的API，支持逐属性参数设置、灵活的关键帧系统、内置缓动效果和增强的CSS变换。此外，它还支持SVG图形变形、线条绘制和路径跟随，并可以通过Scroll Observer API实现滚动同步动画。Anime.js 提供高级交错效果和拖拽功能，并支持响应式动画和模块化导入，以保持较小的包体积。该库还包括详细的文档和示例代码，帮助开发者快速上手。Anime.js 是免费的，并依赖赞助商的支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一个网站主页、其动画效果、API设计及文档的评价和看法

不同观点：
• Nijikokun和majora2007对主页和文档表达了高度赞赏，尤其对WAAPI（Web Animations API）感到兴奋，认为整个项目非常出色。
• jacobgkau和monetus注意到主页在移动端浏览器的流畅性超出预期，特别提到在非传统安卓浏览器上的良好表现。
• pentagrama强调了主页在移动浏览器上的复杂动画表现，将其比作高端PC游戏的流畅体验。
• iamunr和cynicalpeace等用户主要对文档的设计表示赞赏，认为其本身就像艺术品。
• steve_adams_86对API设计和文档表示肯定，认为设计周到且易于理解，增加了使用该库的信心。
• thih9特别提到在Safari移动端上动画与浏览器 scroll 指示器的互动效果，认为其无缝更新令人印象深刻。
• pacomerh认为CSS Transforms的高效性使其成为GSAP（一个常用动画库）的轻量级替代方案。

补充讨论：
• rgovostes提出关于创作工具的问题，询问是否有类似Lottie的工具，还是只能通过代码实现。
• leptons对项目源码使用JavaScript并带有类型注释表示赞赏，同时指出编译后的文件比预期小，表示很可能会使用该库。
• 多个用户（如anon1094、adrianvoica、JusticeJuice）简单表达了对主页的赞叹，但未深入讨论技术细节。

争议焦点：
• 目前评论中没有明显争议，用户普遍对该网站主页、动画效果、API及文档持积极评价。唯一的潜在问题可能是pacomerh提出的关于创作工具的疑问，但未引发讨论。

data.title: Show HN: Novanode, Global load balancing with Caddy, no vendor lock-in
data.author: martianE
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于技术方案及其应用的讨论

不同观点：
• Snawoot分享了一个与供应商无关的技术方案，提供了具体操作指南的链接。这个方案被描述为“粗略但真正独立于供应商”的解决方案，但未详细解释具体操作细节。

• quicksilver03对Snawoot的方案提出了实际操作中的问题，特别是如何在区域A宕机时将流量重定向到区域B，以及在一个区域内一个节点宕机时的处理方法。这表明quicksilver03关注方案在实际故障情况下的有效性与可操作性。

• mlhpdx讨论了在构建类似系统时，每个区域的固定成本对实验者和大团队来说都是一个障碍。他指出，尽管成本在整体预算中不算高，但足以阻止个人或团队随意搭建和维护非生产环境。他还提到，现有的负载均衡方案虽然部署快速，但在按使用量计费方面有所欠缺，这使得长期运行半闲置堆栈的成本较高。

• codegeek对Caddy（一种开源的Web服务器和反向代理工具）表示兴趣，并询问该方案是否支持SSL终止和一般反向代理功能。codegeek希望有一个托管的Caddy集群，以便无需直接配置Caddyfiles或API就能使用所有Caddy功能。

• metadat则对项目名称的读音和来源表示好奇，属于对项目细节的轻松提问，没有涉及技术深度。

• trevorhinesley对多区域部署的具体技术实现表示疑问，特别是是否涉及Anycast技术。这表明他关注多区域部署的技术细节和实现方式。

• revskill表达了对整体方案的不理解，仅拥有VPS（虚拟专用服务器）后该如何操作并不明确，显示出对项目入门指导的需求。

补充讨论：
• 该讨论中涉及了多个技术细节，包括流量重定向、节点故障处理、固定成本对实验的影响、按使用量计费的需求、SSL终止及反向代理功能，以及Anycast技术的应用。
• 争议的焦点主要集中在方案的可操作性和成本问题上，尤其是对于个人实验者和小团队而言，如何在保持方案有效性的同时降低成本是一个关键问题。
• 不同参与者对技术细节的关注点各异，有的关注实际操作中的故障处理，有的则关注方案的成本和易用性。

data.title: Showcase: Working on a voice/text chat app in a cyberpunk style
data.author: b0bben
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[对一款类似赛博朋克风格的程序开发的看法和潜在市场兴趣]

不同观点：
• **indigoabstract的观点**：认为该程序的界面看起来像是黑客游戏的用户界面，可能是在赞赏其独特风格，暗示其视觉效果具有未来感和科技感，符合赛博朋克美学。

• **b0bben的观点**：
  1. 对现代程序感到无聊，渴望在生活中加入更多赛博朋克元素。
  2. 分享了个人开发经历：曾经花费大量资金开发了一个不受欢迎的社区平台，吸取教训后，现在开发自己真正感兴趣的项目。
  3. 当前项目虽然处于早期阶段，但已经带来了极大的工作乐趣和使用体验。
  4. 试图让朋友们从Discord转移到这个新平台，并试探公众对语音/文本聊天应用程序的兴趣，希望将其发展成一个面向大众的产品。

补充讨论：
• **争议的焦点**：目前没有明显争议，但b0bben对现有市场需求的评估可能存在不确定性，尤其是从Discord等成熟平台吸引用户的难度。

• **重要论据和例子**：
  - b0bben提到自己曾开发不受欢迎的社区平台，并从中吸取教训，强调了开发自己真正感兴趣的项目的重要性。
  - 提到《Neuromancer》这本书，表明其对赛博朋克文化的热爱，以及这种文化对其项目开发的影响。

• **其他值得注意的讨论点**：b0bben寻求公众对其项目的反馈，并特别要求“生鲜”的反馈（Sushi-style feedback），显示出其对项目改进和市场适应性的开放态度。

总结来看，讨论主要围绕b0bben正在开发的赛博朋克风格程序的开发动机、当前进展和市场潜力展开，indigoabstract对界面风格的赞赏也为讨论增添了积极的反馈。

data.author: dang

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欢迎Tom成为Hacker News（HN）的新任公开 moderator，以及对HN社区和现有moderator团队的评价与期望。

不同观点：
• 感谢与欢迎：多数评论对Tom的加入表示欢迎和感谢，赞扬了他多年对社区的支持。例如，rurp、raphman和noleary都表达了对HN社区和moderator团队的赞赏，强调了社区长久以来的高质量和稳定性。
• 幽默与调侃：部分评论以幽默方式回应Tom的加入，例如codetrotter对Tom名字发音的调侃，以及koolba建议给Tom一个新用户名“darn”来制造混淆。
• 对社区运营的建议：keepamovin提出了一个功能建议，希望可以私密地“收藏”用户，以便跟踪他们发表的言论。这一建议引出了对HN现有功能和用户体验的讨论。

补充讨论：
• 对moderator工作的认可：GVRV回顾了Tom在大学期间对CS和创业俱乐部的贡献，强调了他作为moderator的合适性。hakaneskici和isoprophlex则强调了moderator团队在维护社区质量方面的不懈努力和重要性。
• 对HN独特氛围的赞扬：ddingus和scrapcode都提到了HN独特的社区氛围，认为这是一个充满智力刺激和健康讨论的地方，并对此表示感激。
• 对moderator团队透明度的关注：palmotea提出了对是否存在其他秘密moderator的疑问，这涉及到社区对moderator团队透明度的关注。

争议焦点：
• 目前评论中未见明显争议，主要以正面评价和建议为主。不过，keepamovin的功能建议可能引发对HN现有功能体系和用户体验的进一步讨论。

总体来看，评论主要集中在对Tom加入moderator团队的欢迎和感谢，以及对HN社区长期以来高质量讨论环境的认可和期望。同时，也有一些幽默调侃和功能建议，为讨论增添了多样性。

• 感谢与欢迎：多数评论对Tom的加入表示欢迎和感谢，赞扬了他多年对社区的支持。例如，rurp、raphman和noleary都表达了对HN社区和moderator团队的赞赏，强调了社区长久以来的高质量和稳定性。
• 幽默与调侃：部分评论以幽默方式回应Tom的加入，例如codetrotter对Tom名字发音的调侃，以及koolba建议给Tom一个新用户名“darn”来制造混淆。
• 对社区运营的建议：keepamovin提出了一个功能建议，希望可以私密地“收藏”用户，以便跟踪他们发表的言论。这一建议引出了对HN现有功能和用户体验的讨论。

补充讨论：
• 对moderator工作的认可：GVRV回顾了Tom在大学期间对CS和创业俱乐部的贡献，强调了他作为moderator的合适性。hakaneskici和isoprophlex则强调了moderator团队在维护社区质量方面的不懈努力和重要性。
• 对HN独特氛围的赞扬：ddingus和scrapcode都提到了HN独特的社区氛围，认为这是一个充满智力刺激和健康讨论的地方，并对此表示感激。
• 对moderator团队透明度的关注：palmotea提出了对是否存在其他秘密moderator的疑问，这涉及到社区对moderator团队透明度的关注。

争议焦点：
• 目前评论中未见明显争议，主要以正面评价和建议为主。不过，keepamovin的功能建议可能引发对HN现有功能体系和用户体验的进一步讨论。

总体来看，评论主要集中在对Tom加入moderator团队的欢迎和感谢，以及对HN社区长期以来高质量讨论环境的认可和期望。同时，也有一些幽默调侃和功能建议，为讨论增添了多样性。

data.title: The Steam Deck is software-freedom friendly
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了Steam Deck的成功不仅在于其硬件性能或电池寿命，而在于其基于Linux系统的开放性和兼容性哲学。Steam Deck通过Proton软件层实现了对大量PC游戏的兼容，推动了Linux游戏支持的显著提升。与许多限制用户自由的设备不同，Steam Deck允许用户自由安装各种软件和游戏启动器，甚至可以作为桌面电脑使用，体现了对用户自由和设备所有权的高度尊重。文章还赞扬了Valve对设备维修和开放市场的支持，认为Steam Deck展示了商业利益与用户公民权益可以共存的可能性。不过，文章也提及Valve的企业文化曾受到批评。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Valve及其产品（尤其是Steam和Steam Deck）的消费者友好性、技术实现、市场定位以及对游戏行业的长期影响。

不同观点：
• **Valve的消费者友好性**：
  - [TehCorwiz] 认为Valve非常注重消费者体验，Steam提供了一个低压力的销售环境，功能设计以用户体验为中心，例如允许家长控制、不随意更改用户设置等。相比之下，其他平台如Epic的体验较差。
  - [whytevuhuni] 认为Valve并非圣徒，尤其是在游戏分发平台的垄断地位上，但他们确实比其他公司更注重用户体验，继承了“不作恶”的理念。

• **Steam Deck的技术与市场定位**：
  - [glenstein] 强调Steam Deck是Valve长期技术发展的成果，源自早期的Steam Machines项目，并成功推动了Linux生态系统的发展。虽然Steam Machines在初期未被广泛接受，但它们为Steam Deck的成功奠定了基础。
  - [craftkiller] 支持Steam Deck，特别是它对Linux系统的支持，但也表达了对独占游戏（如任天堂游戏）无法在Steam上获取的不满，认为这导致了不必要的硬件浪费。
  - [danso] 指出Switch 2可能在硬件上更强大且价格相近，但Steam的杀手锏是其更便宜且更广泛的游戏库。

• **软件自由与技术细节**：
  - [seba_dos1] 认为Steam Deck并非特别注重软件自由，只是没有特意限制它，这与Valve的无为而治态度有关。
  - [accurrent] 赞赏Steam Deck利用开源软件进行商业产品开发，并希望其他制造商能效仿，而不是捆绑Windows系统。
  - [dezzadk] 对Steam Deck依赖Wine技术实现游戏兼容性表示不满，认为这忽视了原生Linux端口的重要性，并指出Valve的商业化行为与其他公司无异。

补充讨论：
• **Steam Deck的实用性与用户体验**：
  - [GardenLetter27] 分享了Steam Deck的多功能用途，从游戏到控制机器人等，表明它不仅限于游戏设备。
  - [Fwirt] 强调Steam Deck作为PC游戏的“主机化”设备，解决了PC游戏兼容性问题，并提供了类似主机的无缝体验。
  - [thih9] 关心游戏控制器的兼容性问题，询问是否需要手动映射控制。

• **对未来和公司发展的担忧**：
  - [jerf] 提到Steam Deck甚至比被破解的Switch更好用，无需进行复杂的破解操作。
  - [cheeseomlit] 表达了对Valve未来发展的担忧，担心Gaben离世后公司可能会被收购或上市，影响其当前的友好形象。

争议焦点：
• **Steam Deck对开源和原生Linux的支持**：一方认为Valve通过Steam Deck推动了Linux生态系统的发展，另一方则批评其过度依赖Wine技术，忽视了原生Linux端口的维护。
• **Valve的商业行为**：虽然许多人赞赏Valve的消费者友好态度，但也有人指出其在平台垄断和商业化方面的潜在问题。

43567923.article_content:
The
Steam Deck
is a great gaming system. This isn’t because of it’s great battery life. A Nintendo Switch would probably have better battery life. It’s not because of its great performance. I don’t usually play AAA games, so I wouldn’t know. The Steam Deck is great because of the philosophy on which it is built.
The popularity of Steam Decks is directly tied to the betterment of support for games on Linux. This is because the Steam Deck really is a linux computer in a handheld form-factor with a gamepad, among other things, attached to it. According to
ProtonDB
, over 5000 PC games are certified Verified on the Steam Deck, and over 15,000 games are considered playable. This means that there are tens of thousands of games that can be run on Linux in some way.
Thanks to Steam’s efforts, the state of compatibility of games on Linux systems have heavily improved. Not all these thousands of games running on the Deck have binaries that run natively on Linux. Pivotal to the success of the Deck is Proton, a middle-layer compatibility software, that makes this (mostly) seamless emulation possible. Nonetheless, the greater the adoption of Decks, the likelier we are to normalize prioritizing game-builds for Linux.
We run software because it serves us some purpose. In this, running software is no different from utilizing everyday objects, and playing games are no different from running software. Yet, this teleological view of computing would miss a lot of context. When picking an operating system, we may want to make a choice that aligns with the goals of transparency or software freedom. But this would not be realistic if the programs we would like to run on top are not supported in such an ecosystem. Since large parts of Proton is open-source, and are released under permissive licenses, gaming on a Deck takes us closer to using a principled software stack for daily use.
Purchasing everyday objects give us ownership over them. With media, software and computing equipment, this is less so. When you buy a book, you may lend it to others, sell it, earmark the pages and even rip it in two if you like. This is very different from the experience of buying a smartphone. You can’t run arbitrary programs of your choice on an Android phone without rooting, or on an iPad or an iPhone without jailbreaking. In most scenarios, you’d be forced to sign away your legal ability to root or jailbreak before you can engage with the device in any meaningful way.
The Steam Deck does not engage in this practice. It runs a heavily customized version of Arch Linux. This means that you can plug in a keyboard and mouse into it, and pretend that it is your desktop computer. If you like, you can install the LibreOffice suite on it, and prepare presentations.
The matter of using your computers the way you like is more than just a symbolic debate about the nature of ownership. It is a political matter of freedom of expression. When they control the apps that you run on your device, they are in charge of deciding which content is Kosher, and which content is obscene. It is also an economic matter of having efficient markets. The mythological power of the free market works only when the consumers can switch between different producers at will. When the operators of the market themselves try to capitalize on chokepoints and direct the consumers to buy products from their allies, this is no longer the case.
Switch owners buy games from the Switch Store not because that is the best market, but because that is the only marketplace from which they can install games. This is thankfully, less of a case with the Steam Deck. The Steam Deck encourages you to buy and play Steam games, of course. Nonetheless, I had
no issues
installing
Epic Games
,
GoG
or even
itch.io
launchers on my Deck and playing games from them. The Deck also includes a “non-steam game” tab in its UI to let users conveniently access them.
When your shoe tears up, you are welcome to visit the cobbler of your choice. They all understand the internals of a shoe. And when they need to fix them, they all can gather the nails, glue and the pieces of fabric that they might need. This is less so for many computing products. Many manufacturers try to discourage third party vendors from repairing them. Worse, they sometimes purposely use proprietary parts in their products, replacements of which would be hard to find. Thankfully, Valve has been different. Valve has released
a video
explaining the internal organization of the Steam Deck and how one should approach replacing parts, should they wish to do so.
This post is not really necessarily about the Steam Deck (or Valve Corporation) itself. That said, the Steam Deck is an excellent demonstration that the commercial interest of making profit does not necessarily have to overpower the civic interests of the people.
Valve’s libertarian ideology has not always been an unquestionable force for good.
Some
people
have criticized that their company culture

data.title: Windows debloat script made by Microsoft
data.author: homebrewer
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个PowerShell脚本（RemoveDefaultApps.ps1），用于卸载Windows系统中预装的某些默认应用程序。这些应用包括如Microsoft.BingFinance、Microsoft.BingNews、Microsoft.Solitaire等。脚本通过调用`Get-AppxPackage`和`Remove-AppxPackage`等PowerShell命令来移除用户和系统中的指定应用，并参考了多个微软文档和社区资源。此脚本旨在帮助用户清理不必要的预装软件，以优化系统性能和减少干扰。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软开发者是否可能使用同一脚本处理被移除的应用程序

不同观点：
• 一种观点认为，有可能存在一名微软开发者，在开发或处理被移除的应用程序时，使用了相同的脚本。这种观点带有一些讽刺和幽默的意味，暗示该开发者可能无意中参与了对自己工作的破坏。（例子：”I’d like to think there is a Microsoft developer out there that used this script...”）

• 另一种观点（可能隐含在语气中）是对上述情况表示怀疑，认为微软开发者不太可能如此不小心，或者认为这种情况即便发生也不具代表性。虽然没有明确表达，但这种观点质疑了前者的假设是否现实。

补充讨论：
• 评论中提到的“脚本”和“应用程序被移除”可能涉及某种自动化工具或程序，它们可能在开发环境中被广泛使用，因此有人认为开发者有可能无意中对自己正在开发的应用程序造成影响。
• 评论的语气带有一定的娱乐性质，表明讨论者可能在以一种轻松或讽刺的方式看待开发过程中的失误或意外情况，而不是严肃的指责。
• 争议的焦点在于微软开发者是否会因为使用相同脚本而无意中影响自己的工作成果，一种观点认为存在这种可能性，另一种则表示怀疑。

43571851.article_content:
We predict that the impact of superhuman AI over the next decade will be enormous, exceeding that of the Industrial Revolution.
We wrote a scenario that represents our best guess about what that might look like.
1
It’s informed by trend extrapolations, wargames, expert feedback, experience at OpenAI, and previous forecasting successes.
2
What is this?
How did we write it?
Why is it valuable?
Who are we?
The CEOs of
OpenAI
,
Google DeepMind
, and
Anthropic
have all predicted that AGI will arrive within the next 5 years. Sam Altman
has said
OpenAI is setting its sights on “superintelligence in the true sense of the word” and the “glorious future.”
3
What might that look like? We wrote AI 2027 to answer that question. Claims about the future are often frustratingly vague, so we tried to be as concrete and quantitative as possible, even though this means depicting one of many possible futures.
We wrote two endings: a “slowdown” and a “race” ending. However, AI 2027 is not a recommendation or exhortation. Our goal is predictive accuracy.
4
We encourage you to debate and counter this scenario.
5
We hope to spark a broad conversation about where we’re headed and how to steer toward positive futures. We’re
planning to give out thousands in prizes
to the best alternative scenarios.
Our research on key questions (e.g. what goals will future AI agents have?) can be found
here
.
The scenario itself was written iteratively: we wrote the first period (up to mid-2025), then the following period, etc. until we reached the ending. We then scrapped this and did it again.
We weren’t trying to reach any particular ending. After we finished the first ending—which is now colored red—we wrote a new alternative branch because we wanted to also depict a more hopeful way things could end, starting from roughly the same premises. This went through several iterations.
6
Our scenario was informed by approximately 25
tabletop exercises
and feedback from over 100 people, including dozens of experts in each of AI governance and AI technical work.
“I highly recommend reading this scenario-type prediction on how AI could transform the world in just a few years. Nobody has a crystal ball, but this type of content can help notice important questions and illustrate the potential impact of emerging risks.”
—
Yoshua Bengio
7
We have set ourselves an impossible task. Trying to predict how superhuman AI in 2027 would go is like trying to predict how World War 3 in 2027 would go, except that it’s an even larger departure from past case studies. Yet it is still valuable to attempt, just as it is valuable for the US military to game out Taiwan scenarios.
Painting the whole picture makes us notice important questions or connections we hadn’t considered or appreciated before, or realize that a possibility is more or less likely. Moreover, by sticking our necks out with concrete predictions, and encouraging others to publicly state their disagreements, we make it possible to evaluate years later who was right.
Also, one author wrote a lower-effort AI scenario
before, in August 2021
. While it got many things wrong, overall it was surprisingly successful: he predicted the rise of chain-of-thought, inference scaling, sweeping AI chip export controls, and $100 million training runs—all more than a year before ChatGPT.
Daniel Kokotajlo
(
TIME100
,
NYT piece
) is a former OpenAI researcher whose previous
AI predictions
have
held up well
.
Eli Lifland
co-founded
AI Digest
, did
AI robustness research
, and ranks #1 on the
RAND Forecasting Initiative
all-time leaderboard.
Thomas Larsen
founded the
Center for AI Policy
and did AI safety research at the
Machine Intelligence Research Institute
.
Romeo Dean
is completing a computer science concurrent bachelor’s and master’s degree at Harvard and previously was an
AI Policy Fellow
at the Institute for AI Policy and Strategy.
Scott Alexander, blogger extraordinaire
, volunteered to rewrite our content in an engaging style; the fun parts of the story are his and the boring parts are ours.
For more about our team and acknowledgements, see the
About page
.
Published April 3rd 2025

Mid 2025: Stumbling Agents
The world sees its first glimpse of AI agents.
Advertisements for computer-using agents emphasize the term “personal assistant”: you can prompt them with tasks like “order me a burrito on DoorDash” or “open my budget spreadsheet and sum this month’s expenses.” They will check in with you as needed: for example, to ask you to confirm purchases.
8
Though more advanced than previous iterations like
Operator
, they struggle to get widespread usage.
9
Meanwhile, out of public focus, more specialized coding and research agents are beginning to transform their professions.

data.title: Why is the world losing color?
data.author: trevin
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了当今世界色彩逐渐消失的现象，特别是在汽车颜色、消费品设计和影视色彩运用等方面。数据显示，超过80%的新车是黑、白、灰或银色，消费品颜色也趋于中性化。影视作品的色调也越来越单调，充满灰暗的蓝灰色。这种现象不仅源于工业材料和市场需求，还深植于西方哲学对色彩的长期怀疑。从柏拉图到康德，许多哲学家认为色彩是感官上的干扰，不具备理性价值。现代极简主义和市场趋势进一步推动了这种“惧色症”（Chromophobia）。文章呼吁重新思考色彩在现代生活中的重要性，并努力恢复其运用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：色彩在现代设计、时尚、电影和汽车等领域的使用和变化原因

不同观点：
• crazygringo：认为现代设计更注重中性色，色彩应作为点缀而非主元素。过度使用色彩会造成视觉疲劳，现代品味倾向于用色彩突出重点，而非让所有东西都五颜六色。
• JKCalhoun：热衷于色彩，反对目前市场上的单调颜色选择，特别是在汽车和电影色调上。他认为色彩的减少是市场和设计上的一种损失。
• fguerraz：指出色彩使用减少的原因是市场和经济因素，色彩多样性会导致库存和转售价值问题。制造商为了避免销售困难，选择生产更易销售的颜色。
• colmmacc：分享个人经验，穿着鲜艳颜色让他更容易与人接触，并且在欧洲时尚中较为常见。他主张使用色彩来增加个人风格和亲和力。
• rahkiin：认为汽车颜色选择受价格影响，定制颜色成本高导致消费者选择便宜的基本颜色。如果厂商不收费，可能会有更多颜色选择。
• WD-42：指出Z世代正在拒绝千禧一代的单调美学，并期待更多色彩在艺术、音乐、时尚等领域的回归。
• legitster：为棕色辩护，认为棕色是一种温暖且实用的颜色，能够与其他颜色很好地搭配，并且在自然光下表现良好。
• roughly：从历史角度分析，指出西方文化中的色彩使用受到古希腊和罗马雕塑及建筑的"纯净美学"影响，尽管这些作品原本是多彩的。
• hoherd：提到RGB LED灯光对室内装饰的影响，以及色盲对个人颜色选择的影响。
• jillesvangurp：认为设计师互相模仿导致单调的设计风格，主张原创设计以脱颖而出。
• techpineapple：提出色彩地位的变化可能与社会阶层和影响者文化有关，从过去的中产阶级家庭转向现在的富裕影响者文化。
• liampulles：指出不同地区的色彩使用文化差异，例如南非比荷兰更喜欢使用鲜艳的颜色。
• munificent：对文章持怀疑态度，认为色彩变化是由多种不相关的原因导致的，包括历史文物保存、音乐动态范围竞争和市场趋势等。
• vvpan：提到文章的作者有白人民族主义/新纳粹倾向，暗示文章可能带有偏见。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于色彩使用的审美和实用性，以及其背后的经济和社会因素。一些人认为过度使用色彩会造成视觉疲劳，而另一些人则认为减少色彩使用是市场和经济压力所致。
• 文化差异和个人经历对颜色偏好的影响也是讨论的重要方面，不同地区和文化背景下的人们对颜色的接受度和使用习惯不同。
• 文章作者的背景信息引发了对文章客观性和潜在偏见的质疑。

Walk around in the average parking lot, and you’ll find yourself in a sea of black, white, and silver vehicles. Watch Netflix at home or catch a film in the theaters, and you’ll get the same washed-out color grade on either screen. Glance at the logos of the world’s largest companies, and you’ll notice a shrinking palette.
It all points to one thing: color is vanishing from our world.
This isn’t just a hunch. Studies of everything from car paint to consumer objects show that we’re in the midst of a vast aesthetic shift. What used to be vibrant has become sterile. What used to pop out and catch our attention now fades into the background.
The question is — why?
The answer isn’t just about fashion or materials, but is rooted in a much older understanding of the relationship between color and truth.
Here’s why color is disappearing from our world, and what we can do to bring it back…

A Monochrome World
The colors around us aren’t just changing. They’re disappearing.
According to major auto paint suppliers, more than 80% of new cars are now grayscale. Black, white, gray, and silver dominate the roads. Reds, blues, and greens in auto production are increasingly rare.
It’s not just cars — a study of over 7,000 objects in the UK’s Science Museum found that the colors of consumer goods have been steadily neutralized since 1800. Bright, saturated tones have been giving way to gray, beige, and taupe for centuries.
Graphic design has followed a similar trend. Streaming platforms, fashion brands, and e-commerce hubs are consistently rebranding in black-and-white. Most recently, HBO’s move to rename its service “Max” was accompanied by a logo redesign that stripped away its original blue — replacing it, of course, with stark white text on a black background.
Even cinema has gone gray. Although Ridley Scott’s
Napoleon
was shot on vivid, richly colored sets, its final color-grade — like that of many historical dramas — washes out all the colors in a somber, blueish-gray tint. It’s a visual style that has become so ubiquitous that directors like Wes Anderson are often considered “unorthodox” for their use of vibrant color in film.
On the surface, there are some straightforward reasons for this. Industrial materials like steel and plastic, for example, are produced in neutral shades. Grayscale branding for logos is easier to reproduce and scale. Muted palettes are less likely to alienate customers.
But this isn't the whole story. To fully understand why color is disappearing from our world, we have to go further back…
The Philosophers’ Suspicion of Color
Color has always had a strange status in Western philosophy — and more often than not, that status is second-class.
In
Chromophobia
, art theorist David Batchelor argues that the devaluation of color can be traced to the very birth of Western thought. From Plato onward, color was treated as a distraction: sensory noise that got in the way of rational understanding.
Plato described the world of appearances as a deceptive “prison-house,” i.e., a realm of illusion where truth could only be grasped by looking beyond the senses. Color, tied directly to sensation, was thus something to overcome — not to embrace.
Aristotle echoed the sentiment. In
Poetics
, he argued that the power of artwork lay in its structure, not its palette:
“A random distribution of the most attractive colors would never yield as much pleasure as a definite image without color.”
For Aristotle, it’s form that holds meaning — not hue.
This view persisted through the Enlightenment, with German philosopher Immanuel Kant arguing that while color may add charm to art, it has no bearing on true aesthetic judgment. In his view, color neither touches reason nor elevates the mind.
The underlying theory in all of these cases is that while color is sensory, unstable, and chaotic, form is rational, stable, and pure. Once you see this bias, you begin to notice how deeply it has shaped the modern world — and how it helps explain our current retreat into colorlessness.

• fguerraz：指出色彩使用减少的原因是市场和经济因素，色彩多样性会导致库存和转售价值问题。制造商为了避免销售困难，选择生产更易销售的颜色。
• colmmacc：分享个人经验，穿着鲜艳颜色让他更容易与人接触，并且在欧洲时尚中较为常见。他主张使用色彩来增加个人风格和亲和力。
• rahkiin：认为汽车颜色选择受价格影响，定制颜色成本高导致消费者选择便宜的基本颜色。如果厂商不收费，可能会有更多颜色选择。
• WD-42：指出Z世代正在拒绝千禧一代的单调美学，并期待更多色彩在艺术、音乐、时尚等领域的回归。
• legitster：为棕色辩护，认为棕色是一种温暖且实用的颜色，能够与其他颜色很好地搭配，并且在自然光下表现良好。

• hoherd：提到RGB LED灯光对室内装饰的影响，以及色盲对个人颜色选择的影响。
• jillesvangurp：认为设计师互相模仿导致单调的设计风格，主张原创设计以脱颖而出。

A 6‑Hour Time-Stretched Version of Brian Eno’s
Music For Airports
: Meditate, Relax, Study
in
Music
|   	March 17th, 2025
3 Comments
Writ­ing in his 1995 diary about his sem­i­nal ambi­ent album
Music for Air­ports
, Eno remem­bered his ini­tial thoughts going into it: “I want to make a kind of music that pre­pares you for dying–that doesn’t get all bright and cheer­ful and pre­tend you’re not a lit­tle appre­hen­sive, but which makes you say to your­self, ‘Actu­al­ly, it’s not that big a deal if I die.’”
Cre­at­ed in 1978 from sec­onds-long tape loops from a much longer improv ses­sion with musi­cians includ­ing Robert Wyatt,
Music for Air­ports
start­ed the idea of slow, med­i­ta­tive music that aban­doned typ­i­cal major and minor scales, brought in melod­ic ambi­gu­i­ty, and began the explo­ration of sounds that were designed to exist some­where in the back­ground, beyond the scope of full atten­tion.
For those who think 50 min­utes is too short and those piano notes too rec­og­niz­able, may we sug­gest this 6‑hour, time-stretched ver­sion of the album, cre­at­ed by YouTube user “Slow Motion TV.” The tonal field is the same, but now the notes are no attack, all decay. It’s gran­u­lar as hell, but you could imag­ine the whole piece unspool­ing unno­ticed in a ter­mi­nal while a flight is delayed for the third time. (Maybe that’s when the accep­tance of death hap­pens, when you’ve giv­en up on ever get­ting home?)
Unlike
Music for Films
, which fea­tured sev­er­al tracks Eno had giv­en to film­mak­ers like Derek Jar­man, it took some time for
Music for Air­ports
to be real­ized in its intend­ed loca­tion: being piped in at a ter­mi­nal at La Guardia, New York, some­time in the 1980s. And that was just a one-time thing.
?si=6VMY_yEfZdFDZbp6
The album seemed des­tined for per­son­al use only, but then in 1997 the mod­ern ensem­ble Bang on a Can played it live, trans­lat­ing the ran­dom­ness of out-of-sync tape loops into music nota­tion. Over the years they’ve per­formed it at air­ports in Brus­sels, the Nether­lands and Liv­er­pool, and in 2015 the group brought it to Ter­mi­nal 2 of San Diego Inter­na­tion­al.
Writ­ing for KCET, Alex Zaragoza report­ed
that “cry­ing babies, echoes of rolling suit­cas­es and board­ing pass­es serv­ing as tick­ets to the con­cert failed to remind any­one that they were, indeed, at one of the busiest air­ports in the coun­try. Even the tell­tale announce­ments were there:
Air­port secu­ri­ty is every­one’s respon­si­bil­i­ty. Do not leave bags unat­tend­ed
.”
And then in 2018,
Lon­don City Air­port played the orig­i­nal album
in a day-long loop for the album’s 40th anniver­sary.
As site-spe­cif­ic mul­ti-media art builds pop­u­lar­i­ty in the 21st cen­tu­ry with increas­ing­ly cheap­er and small­er tech­nol­o­gy, we might hope to hear ambi­ent drones, and not clas­sic rock or pop, in more and more land­scapes.
Note: An ear­li­er ver­sion of this post appeared on our site in 2019.

data.title: Show HN: Chip-8 emulator written in JavaScript
data.author: atum47
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了victorqribeiro开发的Chip8js项目，一个用JavaScript编写的Chip-8模拟器。该项目包含20个星标和0个分支。Chip8js支持通过键盘控制，按键包括1, 2, 3, 4, q, w, e, r, a, s, d, f, z, x, c, v。项目文件包括JavaScript代码、ROM文件、README说明、演示和游戏数据等。主要技术栈为JavaScript（94.6%）和HTML（5.4%）。项目页面提供了在线演示链接。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一位开发者首次尝试编写模拟器，选择了CHIP-8，并使用了tiny.js来处理显示部分，试图模拟老式显示器的发光效果。

不同观点：
• atum47：分享了自己作为初学者选择CHIP-8作为第一个模拟器项目的经验，并提到使用了tiny.js来处理显示部分，目的是模拟老式显示器的发光效果。这表明他对CHIP-8的简单性有一定的认可，并尝试通过图形效果增强模拟体验。

• asciimov：质疑该项目是否几天前已经发布过，暗示这可能是重复发布。这可能反映出对内容重复的关注，或者只是单纯的询问。

• bitwize：对CHIP-8发表了评论，称其为“可以说是世界上第一个幻想游戏机”，这是一种对CHIP-8历史地位的肯定和评价，带有一定的技术背景和历史视角。

• ghffcvb：对atum47的工作表示赞赏，给予了积极的反馈，但没有深入技术讨论，只是简单的赞扬。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：目前没有明显的技术争议，但asciimov的评论可能暗示了对内容重复的轻微不满或疑惑。
• 技术细节：讨论中提到了CHIP-8的简单性、tiny.js的使用以及模拟老式显示器效果的具体实现，这些都是技术层面的细节。
• 历史评价：bitwize对CHIP-8作为“幻想游戏机”的评价提供了一个历史背景，可能引发对CHIP-8在游戏机历史中地位的进一步讨论。

总结：该讨论围绕一个CHIP-8模拟器项目展开，包含了项目实现的技术细节、对项目重复发布的质疑以及对CHIP-8历史地位的评价。整体氛围较为轻松，主要以分享和鼓励为主。

data.title: Microsoft pulls back on datacenter ambitions
data.author: nikcub

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对开源项目贡献的激励机制及其实际效果

不同观点：
• **nikcub** 认为当前的开源项目贡献机制存在问题，尤其是在激励贡献者方面。他指出，很多贡献者在没有获得足够认可或回报的情况下，容易感到倦怠并退出项目。他提到，即便是大规模的公司支持项目，也没有很好地解决这一问题。nikcub 强调，需要重新设计激励机制，让贡献者能获得更长久的动力。

• **支持现有机制的观点** 认为，开源项目的贡献本身是自愿的，贡献者在参与时就应了解并接受这一性质。有人指出，现有的荣誉激励（如在项目中被提及、获得社区尊重等）已经足够，且开源项目的文化和精神就在于无偿贡献。这种观点认为，过度的物质激励可能会扭曲开源精神，导致项目变得商业化。

• **混合激励机制的观点** 提出，可以结合荣誉激励和物质激励。例如，通过奖金、资助计划或提供职业发展机会等方式，让贡献者不仅获得精神上的满足，还能在物质上有所回报。这种观点的支持者认为，这不仅能激励更多人参与，还能提高贡献的质量和持续性。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点** 在于如何在保持开源精神的同时，有效地激励贡献者。一些人担心物质激励会改变开源社区的本质，使其变得功利化；而另一些人则认为，开源社区需要与时俱进，找到适应现代社会的方式来吸引和留住优秀贡献者。

• **具体例子** 被提到，诸如 Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 和其他类似的资助项目，是目前一些大公司支持开源贡献的有效方式。这些项目通过提供资金支持，吸引学生和新人参与开源，但 nikcub 认为这些措施还远远不够，且覆盖面有限。

• **社区建设** 被认为是另一种激励方式，通过建立更紧密的社区关系和提供更多学习和成长机会，来增强贡献者的归属感和成就感。这种观点强调软性激励，如指导计划、知识分享和团队合作等。

通过这些观点的讨论，可以看出开源贡献激励机制是一个复杂且多维度的问题，涉及文化、经济和社区动态等多个方面。

data.article_summary: 文章探讨了硅胶如何成为全球广泛使用的防潮材料。硅胶颗粒内部充满微小孔隙，具有极高的吸水能力，能够吸收高达自身重量40%的水蒸气，其内部表面积可达数百平方米。这种特性使其被广泛应用于各种产品中，如食品包装、电子设备和衣物等，以防止潮湿和霉变。硅胶的吸水能力有上限，但通过计算可以确定所需硅胶量以达到理想的防潮效果。此外，硅胶还可用于维持特定湿度，如在博物馆中用于保护艺术品。硅胶的广泛应用始于20世纪初，由研究人员Walter Patrick发明并取得专利，通过混合“水玻璃”和酸制成。硅胶因其高效的防潮性能，已成为现代包装和保存的重要材料。
